evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `_timer_schedule_seconds` still computes `overall` only from `OnCalendar`, `OnUnitActiveSec`, `OnUnitInactiveSec`, and `AccuracySec`; it never reads `RandomizedDelaySec`. Since systemd adds a declared randomized delay to timer activation, a template can pass preflight with an understated completion bound. This is an ordinary correctness repair in existing behavior, not a new requirement.
